title: Karnataka High Court refuses to cancel bail of five accused in Renukaswamy murder case
description: The Karnataka High Court has refused to cancel the bail granted to five men accused in the murder case of Renukaswamy involving actor Darshan Thoogudeepa [State of Karnataka Vs Dhanraj @ Raju @ Dhanaraju D & Others].Justice S Rachaiah, by an order dated June 10, dismissed petitions filed by the State seeking the cancellation of bail granted to Puttaswamy @ Pavan K, Raghavendra N, Nandeesh, Dhanraj @ Raju @ Dhanaraju D and V Vinay (respondents/ accused Nos. 3, 4, 5, 9 and 10 in the murder cas
